releaseNotes: AURA 3.6.0 is a pre-beta robustness release: it now tolerates sample-rate changes, mono tracks, corrupt/8-hour files, faster-than-realtime bounces, and NaN from a broken upstream plugin (a single bad block no longer freezes the meters). AURA Link handles bypassed masters, vanished senders, slot exhaustion, and duplicate stems, and works with no editor open. Unreadable files and long analyses now give clear feedback.
